title: Yudan Beribi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Kiddushin 21b](https://www.sefaria.org/Kiddushin.21b.7), Rabbi Elazar says, “Yudan Beribi used to expound.” ([Rashi explains](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Kiddushin.21b.7.1) that Yudan was his name and he was a great man of his generation.) [Bekhorot 36b (37b in the linked edition)](https://www.sefaria.org/Bekhorot.37b.12-13) cites: “The rabbis taught—Rabbi Yudan said: Berabi used to expound: When they pierce,” etc., “and the Sages say,” etc. This wording suggests that Rabbi Yudan said that Beribi used to expound. The source, however, is [Sifrei, Reeh](https://www.sefaria.org/Sifrei_Devarim.122.5), on “You shall take the awl,” where it reads: “Rabbi Elazar said: Yudan Beribi used to expound.” If so, he is Rabbi Elazar ben Shammua.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Beribi is an honorific for an eminent scholar. Hyman’s final identification is conditional on his reading of the attribution.

Hyman cites Bekhorot 36b. The corresponding passage is on 37b in the linked edition. Its Hebrew reads אמר רבי יודן בריבי, whereas its English supplies Rabbi Elazar, who is explicitly named in the linked Sifrei. [Heilprin’s entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1668&lang=en) also cites Kiddushin.
